lede: The school board votes Tuesday on a flood-related budget appropriation for the coming school year — real money moving in response to real damage — and that alone is worth paying attention to. The Telluride Hospital District board takes up the Two Site Model for the new medical facility on Thursday, a decision that will shape what gets built and where for decades. Layered in: the Ethics Commission begins drafting a formal Code of Conduct for Town officials, and TMVOA moves to stand up a Workforce Housing Committee over in Mountain Village.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-related budget appropriation affecting district spending this year.
Commission drafts Code of Conduct recommendation for Telluride elected officials.
County weighs CCAP childcare funding and its budget implications for FY 2026-27.
Hospital board may act on Two Site Model, shaping new facility's scale and location.
TMVOA votes on workforce housing committee formation and updated association policies.
